_: The hooded mascot's other spots (compose.py's 5th argument; 'announcement' is the original, built from vo/line*.wav). Each spot's lines are vo/<spot>/fish[-n].wav and vo/<spot>/licensed[-n].wav, cut into `phrases` on their pauses (the n-1 longest). `talk` is the mascot-only cut's shots: [window, first phrase], a window naming a stretch of a generated shot (compose.py WIN). `montage` (hello and hellopc, montage only) opens on its `open` shots, drops into the chat for phrase `over` on (laid over the empty state and the ask typing) and line `list`'s phrases on the variant's `cues`, then back to the mascot on its `close` shots. `slug` names the gallery ids (hacker-<slug>[-talk][-licensed]-superbot-7dfcf32a).
